comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
5-star Shipwreck located in the East Mediterranean Sea, right along the north coast of Cyprus (the island where Famagusta is located). Archaeology R6 is required.

Note: Athens has a Map Artisan near its main bank who can mark its location in a red circle if you are willing to pay 50,000 ducats.
